name: Video Mix DJ Studio
summary: Mix two YouTube decks with turntables, crossfader, cues, loops, sampled sections, tempo and sampler pads, and jam with friends who share the decks and the queue.

config.title: Video Mix DJ Studio
config.description: Mix two YouTube videos with touch turntables, captured sections, cue points, loops, tempo controls, a crossfader and local drum sampler pads.

permissions.label: Embed the two YouTube videos you choose so they can be mixed in this browser
Search public YouTube video indexes from the studio and load a selected result into a deck
Keep your deck choices, cue points, captured sections, sampler level and saved set in this browser only
Create jam sessions, invite ForkMesh users by name, and share both decks and a video queue with the people who join
Add a Video Mix DJ button to the desktop rail that opens this studio in your browser
